name: Resource Dialog Form
description: Defines the reviewed Workbench modal structure for a compact resource form with keyboard-aware actions.

states: Open Manage Project from a Project menu and inspect the lightweight compact title, dense description, normal-weight field labels, and footer actions.
Open Manage Workspace from a Workspace menu and confirm that its shared compact hierarchy omits key hints because Enter and Escape also operate its nested controls.
Open New Workspace, choose New Worktree, and inspect code-like branch fields, read-only managed-location metadata, and the omission of ambiguous key hints.

useWhen: A compact Workbench resource has passed repository modal admission and needs a titled form with confirm or cancel actions.
The form must share the established dialog body, footer, cancellation, validation, and submission structure.
avoidWhen: The workflow needs a full-page editor, multistep navigation, or a persistent inspector surface.
A destructive decision only needs the shared anchored or modal confirmation pattern without editable fields.
invariants: The title and any decision-relevant description explain the resource and outcome before the first editable field.

Every consumer uses the compact Desktop form-Dialog typography hierarchy: a lightweight compact heading, dense normal-weight supporting copy, normal-weight control text, code typography only for code-like values, and subordinate key hints.
Every editable field has a visible label; placeholders are optional, and contextual descriptions appear only when validation or platform limits matter.
Cancel and submit preserve native form semantics; their buttons expose aria-hidden Esc and Enter Kbd hints together only when neither key has a competing meaning in any editable control.
